subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and make Telegram final-mode TTS use captioned voice-note delivery by default?
rationale: The code path is now coherent, but the PR creates a documented plugin SDK/channel contract and changes user-visible Telegram delivery behavior, which requires maintainer product/API intent rather than another mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept Capability Contract
options.body: Approve `captionedFinalText` as the channel-owned opt-in and proceed once required CI is green, leaving separate-text delivery mode to the existing follow-up issue.

options.title: Keep It Telegram-Internal
options.body: Ask for a narrower bundled Telegram-only implementation without publishing a new SDK capability yet.

options.title: Pause For Delivery-Mode Direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether captioned or separate text-plus-voice should be the preferred Telegram TTS default.

recommendation.title: Accept Capability Contract
recommendation.body: Approve `captionedFinalText` as the channel-owned opt-in and proceed once required CI is green, leaving separate-text delivery mode to the existing follow-up issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass shows the broadest recent ownership across the channel capability resolver, Telegram plugin metadata, and ACP dispatch seams.
